bridge_prompt: Edit this production 2.5D game bridge sprite. Keep its exact pale golden living wood, braided green vine rails and delicate pink flowers style and natural colors. CHANGE CAMERA AND BACKGROUND: bridge must run horizontally LEFT to RIGHT parallel to canvas X axis, BOTH ENDPOINT DECK CENTERS at the SAME Y coordinate. Absolutely no diagonal left-low/right-high composition. Use a high centered elevated camera looking straight at the LONG SIDE, enough to see the broad flat TOP DECK, north/far railing and south/near railing parallel horizontal lines; no vanishing point, no end foreshortening. Deck flat rectangular, not sloped, no stairs; the clear walkable TOP is a wide horizontal rectangular strip with ample depth (roughly 65% of architecture height). Delicate supporting arches BELOW it. Entire bridge including both ends and dangling vines within central 80% of landscape canvas. REMOVE ALL opaque background and ALL colored glow or ground-shadow haze outside architecture; alpha ZERO outside architecture and beneath open arches. This is one isolated complete transparent game sprite, not a scene. No surrounding island, water, ground, labels or text. Precise horizontal orientation is essential because frozen gameplay path has identical endpoint Y.
bridge_alpha_prompt: Remove the ENTIRE background from this isolated game bridge and preserve ALL architecture exactly, including railings, wood deck, hanging vines, flowers, arches and fine leaves. Output transparent-background RGBA cutout. Every pixel of the green/yellow fog and black dark background outside architecture and inside open arch holes must become alpha ZERO. Do not paint a replacement background, do not add shadows or halos. This is background removal ONLY. Preserve source horizontal bridge orientation, original colors, dimensions and sharp native detail.
